def collate_fn(batch):
    tensors = []
    paths = []
    labels = []
    ids = []
    for item in batch:
        img = item["image"]
        tensors.append(
            torchvision.transforms.functional.to_pil(item["image"])
            if hasattr(item, "image")
            else item["image"]
        )
        paths.append(item["path"])
        labels.append(item["label"])
        ids.append(item["id"])
        # Handle padding for variable image inputs (standard pytorch)
        # Since all are same size here, no dynamic padding
    return torch.stack(tensors), torch.cat(paths), torch.cat(labels), torch.cat(ids)


class CustomDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    def __init__(self, images, labels):
        self.images = images
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.images)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = self.images[idx]
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        # Resize
        img = img.resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        # Normalize
        img_array = img.numpy()
        img_tensor = torch.from_numpy(img_array).permute(2, 0, 1).float() / 255.0
        mean = (
            torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406])
            .view(1, 3, 1, 1)
            .unsqueeze(0)
            .expand(img_tensor.size(0), -1, -1, -1)
        )
        std = (
            torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
            .view(1, 3, 1, 1)
            .unsqueeze(0)
            .expand(img_tensor.size(0), -1, -1, -1)
        )
        img_tensor = img_tensor - mean
        img_tensor = img_tensor / std
        return {"image": img_tensor, "index": self.labels[idx]}
